title: Specify source-safe snapshots and scoped import pruning
description: Write executable synthetic regressions before implementation: snapshot output must never unlink its source; a selected-source import must not prune other agents.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Add a third synthetic security specification: automatic SQLite snapshot copies use private unpredictable temporary directories and are removed when connections close, including failure paths. Confirmed previous implementation left permissive copies; source/destination alias rejection must happen before mutation.
